probes.output:
Usage: sdd [options] [command]

团队 AI coding scaffold — 验证工具薄 CLI

Options:
  -V, --version                  output the version number
  -h, --help                     display help for command

Commands:
  init [options]                 初始化 scaffold（hooks + skills + MCP；等价 bash
                                 tools/bootstrap.sh）
  doctor                         环境与骨架自检
  probe [options]                Evaluate deterministic browser/runtime probe
                                 evidence
  deliverable-audit [options]    Audit run deliverables — each completed stage
                                 produced its expected outputs
  workflow-audit [options]       Re-evaluate an existing run against its
                                 current stage prerequisites
  evidence-audit [options]       Audit evidence claims against disk facts and
                                 captured command output
  test-gate [options]            Run the project test suite and persist
                                 sha256-bound evidence
  generation-capture [options]   Capture the current test-file inventory
                                 (before TDD generation)
  generation-evaluate [options]  Evaluate that newly generated tests match the
                                 inventory delta and pass
  delivery-gate [options]        Component-only receipt coverage check; file
                                 inputs cannot authorize managed acceptance; no
                                 dispatch, no writes
  knowledge-closeout [options]   Judge the R06 knowledge closeout obligations
                                 (Kp wiki readback + Kt publish ledger + code
                                 wiki freshness); read-only, no dispatch, no
                                 redeploy
  wiki                           管理 LLMWiki（init / ingest）
  help [command]                 display help for command

Usage: sdd delivery-gate [options]

Component-only receipt coverage check; file inputs cannot authorize managed
acceptance; no dispatch, no writes

Options:
  --contract <file>         TestContract JSON (SDD.Delivery.TestContract v1)
  --receipts <file>         Admitted evidence entries JSON array (produced by
                            the trusted-launcher admission path)
  --policy <file>           Policy JSON { ref, digest }
  --input-digest <sha256>   Current full input digest (sha256 hex)
  --builder-execution <id>  Builder execution id
  --json                    Print a machine-readable report (default: false)
  -h, --help                display help for command
